correctness.rationale: The source defines \(\delta_{\theta,a}=a(\theta-\mathrm{Id})\), \(xr=\theta(r)x+\delta_\theta(r)\), the component direct-sum decomposition, and the Gray map \(a_i\mapsto a_iM_i\). With the printed row, \((1+x^2)(x+1)=x^3+x^2+x+1\), so \(c=(0,g_3,g_3)\) belongs to the code and every ring coordinate is \((0,1,1)\); multiplication by the printed \(M\) gives \((0,1,0)\), hence a weight-\(4\) Gray word. Exact exhaustion of all \(4^5\) words proves \(d=4\) and the displayed enumerator. Exact column-subspace enumeration proves the generalized hierarchy \((4,8,10,11,12)\).
